title: Clients must keep parsing ResourceTable responses even when requesting FIELD_VALUES
answers: Can I delete the ResourceTable parsing path now that we request FIELD_VALUES?
Why does the search client still handle ResourceTable responses?
Unified storage returns a different response shape than requested
body: Invariant: unified storage/search can deploy separately from the Grafana API layer, so an older search server can answer a FIELD_VALUES request with a ResourceTable (no ResultFormat echoed back). Client code that sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES must still be able to parse a ResourceTable response as a fallback — this path is required compatibility handling, not dead code, per pkg/storage/unified/AGENTS.md rule 3. Removing the ResourceTable branch breaks rolling upgrades where search deploys ahead of/behind the API server.
applies: Client code in pkg/services/folder and pkg/services/dashboards that issues resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest and parses the response.
says: Why does the search client still handle old ResourceTable response format?
Can we remove the ResourceTable parsing now that we use FIELD_VALUES?
What happens during rolling upgrade when search and API versions differ?
Why does search return a different response shape than what we requested?
How do we maintain compatibility with older search backend servers?
search: Unified storage search backward-compatibility rule: client code must continue parsing ResourceTable responses even when ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES is requested, because search can deploy separately from the Grafana API layer and older servers answer FIELD_VALUES requests with ResourceTable instead of echoing the format back. Removing ResourceTable parsing breaks rolling upgrades where search deploys ahead of or behind the API server; per pkg/storage/unified/AGENTS.md rule 3, this fallback path is required compatibility handling, not dead code. Applies to client code in pkg/services/folder and pkg/services/dashboards that issues resourcepb.ResourceSearchRequest and parses responses. Test coverage exists in pkg/services/folder/folderimpl/folder_unifiedstorage_test.go:TestSearchFolders.
